title: Lamb Tagine Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional Mexican tacos, infused with the rich flavors of a Tunisian-inspired lamb tagine.
instructions: Season the lamb with Tunisian Spice Blend, salt, and black pepper.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook the lamb for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
Shred the lamb with two forks and stir in the cumin and chili powder.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the lamb mixture onto a tortilla, topping with cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
